xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: 1. The information provided in Annexure-B w.r.t Statement showing foreign ownership limits has been given as per the corresponding percentages as available on the NSDL ISSUER portal of the Company for the respective quarters. The percentage pertains to FIIs/FPIs/NRI (Repatriable) and other Foreign Investments (includes indirect Foreign investment, if any). 2. As per the NSE issued Circular Ref. No.: NSE/CML/2022/31 dated June 30, 2022, on the inference of the below FAQ: a. If a shareholder is falling under more than one category in Table III, then the same shall be classified under which category? Categorization and disclosure of each shareholding category should be carried out in the order prescribed in the format of the shareholding pattern. If a shareholder is falling under more than one category, then the same shall be classified in the category falling first in the order prescribed in the format. Shareholding under any of the categories shall be unique and will not be duplicated under multiple categories. Therefore, the Company has classified the shares held by Director and their relatives (excluding independent directors & Nominee Directors) in the first category as the shareholder is also a Key Managerial Personnel. The guidance of the FAQs is maintained. b. What needs to be classified under the sub-category of Shareholders who are represented by a nominee Director on the board of the Company or have the right to nominate a representative (i.e. Director) on the board of the Listed Entity? This sub-category of shareholders includes those who are represented by a nominee Director on the board of the Listed Entity (excluding directors nominated by small shareholders as per section 151 of Companies Act, 2013) or have the right to nominate a representative (i.e. Director) on the board of the Listed Entity (excluding entitlement of small shareholders as per section 151 of Companies Act, 2013). The Company do have nominated directors from Andhra Pradesh Industrial Development Corporation Limited and Thai Union Group Public Company Limited. Therefore, the same is classified accordingly & is further recorded in the sub-category of shareholders column. 3. The Foreign Direct Investment is available in Part B (Table III) Serial No. 02 Institutions category and the same is not available under Non-institutions. The shareholder Thai Union Group Public Company Limited is classified as a Non-institution by virtue of the registration with the Depository and category of FDI is only available under Institutions category. Therefore, due to unavailability of category of FDI, the Company is showing under Non-Institution-Foreign Companies. 4. Pursuant to the NSE FAQs dated 09 July 2025, wherein companies have been instructed to disclose the promoters/promoter group with nil shareholding until approval for reclassification is granted by the concerned Stock Exchanges, we wish to place the following on record. During the financial year 20252026, Inter-se transfers were made between Mrs. Ratna Manikyamba Katneni, Mr. Katneni Uma Maheswara Rao, Mr. Jitendra Prasad Katneni and Mr. Katneni Sarath Babu members of Promoter Group. Consequent to the above transfers, as on March 31, 2026, Mr. Katneni Uma Maheswara Rao and Mr. Jitendra Prasad Katneni each hold 37,500 shares each, while Mrs. Ratna Manikyamba Katneni and Mr. Katneni Sarath Babu hold nil shares. The same has been duly reflected in the shareholding pattern submitted for the current quarter.
